title: Gowlfang
wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Gowlfang | image = Gowlfang.png | title = | gender = Male | race = Gnoll | creature = Humanoid | level = 28 | type = Elite | affiliation = [[Mosshide pack]], [[Dragonmaw clan]] | faction = Boss | aggro = {{Aggro|-1|-1}} | location = [[Dragonmaw Retreat]] | status = Killable | instance = Dragonmaw Retreat }} '''Gowlfang''' is a [[gnoll]] and is the first boss of [[Dragonmaw Retreat]]. He was formerly a [[quest giver]] located at the Mosshide's refuge in the [[Wetlands]]. Once the pack leader of the Mosshide pack, he was exiled by [[Sagepaw]] and left to rot in [[Sparkwater Port]] in [[Durotar]].{{questlong|Neutral|24|Cursed Sagepaw!}} He later managed to travel back to the Wetlands, and was joined by fellow Mosshide that sought to help him become pack leader again. However, after Sagepaw was killed, Gowlfang betrayed those that had aided him and aligned himself with [[Zuluhed the Whacked]] and the [[Dragonmaw clan]], traveling with [[Bogpaw Truthsay]] to the [[Dragonmaw Retreat]] with his pack.{{questlong|Neutral|28D|Gowlfang's Defeat}} ==Quotes== ;Aggro :Who messes with Mosshide? We gnolls are strongest! ;At 50% :No one defeats Gowlfang, I am leader! ;Death :Mosshide is mine!
